target: det(I_(m-1)-Q_m) != 0 for T_m=R Bhat R Ahat with T_m e_0=e_0

rows.external_theorem: GSTP implies a positive simple spectrum.
rows.exact_implication_if_gap_closed: If T_m is GSTP with respect to a proper cone in every exterior power, then eigenvalue 1 of T_m is simple; hence det(I-Q_m) != 0.
rows.missing_hypothesis: Construct and verify a task-specific invariant proper-cone family for all wedge powers of the signed product R Bhat R Ahat.
rows.research_value: This is the cleanest existing theorem that turns an exterior-power positivity statement directly into the required fixed-point simplicity without demanding entrywise positivity of Q_m.

rows.external_theorem: Principal-angle cosines are singular values of a cross-Gram matrix; products of orthogonal projections encode squared principal cosines, with eigenvalue 1 exactly on the common subspace.
rows.exact_implication_if_gap_closed: If T_m is similar to a product/compression of two orthogonal projections whose intersection is exactly span(e_0), then no quotient eigenvalue equals 1 and det(I-Q_m) != 0.
rows.missing_hypothesis: Produce a common-Hilbert-space Gram/projection realization of the normalized Beta-Bernstein half maps and absorb the non-orthogonal R without changing spectrum; then prove the intersection is one-dimensional.
rows.research_value: This precisely formalizes the parent Driver's principal-angle intuition as a strict-transversality lemma.

rows.external_theorem: In the Jacobi Bernstein-Durrmeyer setting the Jacobi polynomials diagonalize the operator and lambda_(n,0)=1 while the remaining lambda_(n,r) lie below 1; arbitrary weights lose the same spectral structure in general.
rows.exact_implication_if_gap_closed: An exact conjugacy of T_m to a Jacobi-type Bernstein-Durrmeyer operator would settle the target by the explicit eigenvalues.
rows.missing_hypothesis: The AP measure is not the operative single Jacobi weight, the two halves use u and u^m, and R is inserted between them. No such conjugacy is known.
rows.research_value: Provides a concrete spectral model but also pinpoints why the standard Durrmeyer theorem cannot simply be quoted.

rows.external_theorem: Classical Bernstein structure and total positivity do not force a unique fixed point; the classical Bernstein operator already fixes all linear polynomials.
rows.missing_hypothesis: A genuinely AP-specific mechanism beyond generic Bernstein/TP structure is mandatory.
rows.research_value: Adversarial kill certificate for any proof that tries to infer simplicity solely from Bernstein positivity, TP basis structure, or a basic composition formula.

rows.external_theorem: The lower Pascal/binomial transform and its inverse are classical structured matrices.
rows.missing_hypothesis: No classical Pascal theorem located here couples R to the shared Beta measure strongly enough to control the spectrum of R Bhat R Ahat.
rows.research_value: Prevents treating R itself as a novel ingredient and redirects effort toward the interaction R + common measure + order map.

rows.external_theorem: The signature (-1)^(k(k-1)/2) is equivalent to a TN matrix with reversed columns; oscillatory matrices have distinct positive eigenvalues.
rows.exact_implication_if_gap_closed: If a natural eigenvalue-preserving transform of the full T_m can be shown oscillatory, then its eigenvalues are simple and the fixed eigenvalue 1 cannot repeat.
rows.missing_hypothesis: The frozen parent theorem proves STP of Ahat and Bhat separately, not oscillation of the signed normalized product. Q_4 itself is not TN because it has a negative entry.
rows.research_value: A valid oscillation route must prove a full-product sign/ordering theorem; factorwise sign regularity by itself is not enough.

rows.external_theorem: No audited source simultaneously contains the AP measure, the u/u^m paired Bernstein coordinates, the normalized two-half-map product, the Pascal-Mobius involution insertions, and the quotient eigenvalue-1 exclusion.
rows.missing_hypothesis: This is a search boundary, not a theorem.
rows.research_value: No exact duplicate was found in the audited surfaces; this does not authorize any novelty claim.

terminal_boundary.strongest_actionable_route_1: GSTP exterior-cone route: construct invariant proper cones for every wedge^j T_m; simple spectrum then closes the target immediately.
terminal_boundary.strongest_actionable_route_2: Principal-angle route: realize T_m as a projection/Gram product and prove the only zero principal angle is the fixed e_0 direction.
terminal_boundary.standard_model_boundary: Jacobi Bernstein-Durrmeyer spectral formulas prove the desired type of simplicity only in a structurally narrower self-adjoint setting and do not survive arbitrary weight / cross-coordinate replacement automatically.
terminal_boundary.negative_controls: Generic Bernstein positivity and generic TP do not imply fixed-point simplicity; direct Q_m oscillation/TN is blocked at m=4 by the frozen negative entry.
